newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones fell by 1.12 points to 5,932.85. PLDT's ADR fell by $0 5/8 to $62 1/4.
* The peso closed at 26.28 to a U.S.dollar from 26.26.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,130.26, down 41.62.

* Philippine September inflation due this morning. A Reuter poll last week predicted inflation would fall below 5.5 percent from 7.9 percent in August. Sun Hung Kai Securities, in an advisory to clients, said latest talk was that inflation had gone down to 4.4 percent for that period.
* Philippine Asia Equity Securities Inc said in a report to clients it expected the market on Friday to "technically rebound as a lot of the issues have been oversold."
